notes.title: Passengers Added + Cargo physics changes + Fixes + Improvements
notes.notes:
Stations can be placed near locations
 Pay is based on distance from each station 
 passengers randomly pick a destinations depending on where you have placed stations
(many improvements to passengers coming soon)
 Cargo friction now changes if resting on a vehicle, it will now slide along the ground rails ect
 Hooked cargo remains less grippy until dropped allowing easier loading
 Removing boat shop and stopping boats from being saved for now i will get back to them when i have time
 Added Multiple new Narrow gauge wagons 
 Changed UI scaling
 Improved power station code

notes.title: Map 1 Ground changes + New Locomotives
notes.notes:
First off i must apologise for messing up peoples world 1 saves but it was the first test world and needed some big improvements ( much of the ground has been smoothed out and many many more miles of flat routes built into the map, cuts though mountains and more) 
Textures trees and grass are yet to be finalised but the ground shape is ready and i wanted to get it out asap. 


https://i.imgur.com/x9YEslI.png


Rendering ---
Optomisation for Bridge support rendering
Optomised Rails without sleepers
More changes to many LOD levels 
Changed the way locotive liverys are applied and saved to allow for more variation in the future(some existing ones may change to be missing untill the get added to the new system)

Traction changes (wheel slip traction has been decresed and static traction has been increased) to bring it closer to real life
Physics improvements to BR24 (no longer wants to hop over every corner)
many other small improvements i lost the notes for sorry. 

New stuff ---
New GP38
New SD40-2
New Euopien Tanker (3 liverys)
New ContainerWagon (3 liverys)
New Narrow Gauge Tanker wagon
New Buildable factory 


Networking ---
More work on making sure cargo vehicles sync propperly(its a hard problem)

notes.title: Rail building Improvements + Economy ballance changes + Fixes
notes.notes:
Economy ballance -- 

 Buy price of cargo goes down with each item sold and slowly goes up over time.
 Log/Lumber production % changed to remove an infinate money loop 


Rail building Improvements --

 Added Left shift Modifier for Lococontrols (slows inputs)
 Added Left shift Modifier for Rail building (slows inputs)
 Added auto smooth feature to rail builder
 Added new medium size open wagon 
 Extended Rail smoothing range 



 Added paint variations to 6/7 plank coal wagons
 Added hints HUD for Forklift
 Improved texture quality for many locos when viewed from a shallow angle (ansio)
 Fixed Trojan smoke not ever stoping 
 Made red flatcar less reflective
 Brake handle on red trailers made yellow
 Added hitbox to LDM  top so cargo does not fall inside
 Fixed Rail can snap to its start point
 Fixed Locomotives not setting correct maxspeed for joining clients untill the reverser was moved.
